tei:div.tei:p: ༁ྃ: zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: chos spyod bag chags rang grol zhes bya ba bar do thos grol gyi cha lag bzhugs so:

kun bzang che mchog zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang : dam pa rigs brgya 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la: gus pas phyag 'tshal bar dor grol nas kyang : 'gro kun sku gsum don la gnas gyur cig: skal ldan las can skyes bu dad ldan rnams: zhi khro 'dus pa'i chos spyod rab gsal 'di: dus gsum kun tu ma brjed bsgom bzlas bya: dang po tshogs bsags yan lag bcu pa ni: skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum dang rigs brgya'i lha: mdun gyi nam mkhar dmigs nas 'di skad do: oṃ āḥhūm̐: nam mkha'i mthar thug zhing khams rab 'byams na: bde gshegs rgya mtsho zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkon mchog rin chen gsum dang yi dam lha: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dam can tshogs bcas la: deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar: 'bral ba med par gus pas skyabs su mchi: skyabs su 'gro ba'i yan lag go: chos nyid dbyings kyi rab 'byams klong yangs nas: shes rab thabs dang thugs rjes skur sprul pa: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i zhi khro rab 'byams rnams: gnas 'dir 'gro ba'i don du gshegs su gsol: spyan 'dren pa'i yan lag go: snang srid rnam dag ye shes dkyil 'khor 'dir: rin chen seng ge la sogs khri steng du: thabs shes dri med nyi zla padma'i steng : zag med dgyes pa chen por bzhugs su gsol: bzhugs su gsol ba'i yan lag go: kun tu bzang mo gsang ba'i bha ga ru: kun tu bzang po zag pa med pas bde: rol pa ye shes rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: yab yum sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo: phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag go: bde gshegs zhi khro rgyal ba rgya mtsho la: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dpag med rnams: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis rnam sprul te: 'gro ba'i don du 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol: mchod pa 'bul ba'i yan lag go: thog med dus nas dug gsum dbang gyur te: sgo gsum sdig sgrib bag chags bcas pa rnams: ngan song 'khor ba'i rgyu bsags thams cad kun:

rab tu gnong zhing 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags: sdig sgrib bshags pa'i yan lag go: chos dbyings kun khyab snang srid bde chen zhing : 'gro don mdzad dang bsod nams byang chub sems: bsod nams ye shes don 'byung thams cad la: dga' ba chen pos rjes su yi rang ngo : rjes su yi rang ba'i yan lag go: phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rdul snyed ston pa rnams: sems can don du thugs dam rgyud bskul te: nam mkha'i mthar thug dbyangs kyis rab gang ba'i: chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor bar bskul: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba'i yan lag go: ji srid 'khor ba'i 'jig rten ma stongs bar: de srid 'gro ba rgya chen don byed cing : mtha' yas sangs rgyas ston pa ma lus kun: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa'i yan lag go: bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa: nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can kun: bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur nas: zhi khro rab 'byams go 'phang myur thob shog: bla med theg pa chen por bsngo ba'i yan lag go: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzña na dhartu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: skye med rnam dag chos dbyings zhing khams nas: 'gag med gsal dag thig le'i gzhal yas su: rin chen khri rkang nyi zla padma'i steng : rang sems ma bcos stong pa'i rang rtsal las: rang rig gsal stong rdo rje sems dpar shar: dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum bcas bzhad: phyag g.yas rig stong rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin: g.yon pas snang stong dril bu dku la brten: dbu la bde gshegs rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rdzogs: longs spyod rdzogs sku dar dang rin chen brgyan: g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs: thugs kar rdo rje hūm̐ la yig brgyas bskor: oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya: nas ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas nas rtog sgrib sbyangs:

ma yengs dam pa rigs brgya'i yang snying 'di: sgrib gnyis sbyangs phyir ci nus bzlas par bya: de ltar sgrib pa sbyangs ba'i rjes su zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i lha tshogs rnams lus dkyil du bsgom zhing gsol ba btab: bar do'i smon lam gdab par 'dod na 'di ltar ro: de nas rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' yi: tsitta rin chen snying gi gzhal yas su: dngas ma lnga ldan 'od lnga'i thig ler gsal: ye shes lnga ldan gsal 'tsher dkyil 'khor du: seng ge glang chen rta mchog rma bya dang : shang shang padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng : sangs rgyas zhi ba sum cu so drug ni: stong gsal ma 'gags 'od lnga'i sku ru gsal: oṃ āḥhūm̐: tsitta snying dbus thig le'i mkha' klong du: thog ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba'i sku: chos sku kun tu bzang po sku mdog mthing : chos dbyings kun tu bzang mo sku mdog dkar: skyil krung mnyam bzhag gnyis med 'khril sbyor rol: gsal stong padma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: dus gsum sangs rgyas spyi myes chen po la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid dag pa'i 'od gsal 'char dus der: kun tu bzang po yab kyis mdun bsus shig: kun tu bzang mo yum gyis mtha' brten cig: kun bzang dbyer med sa la drang du gsol: tshe 'das kyi don du smon lam 'debs na/ bdag sogs zhes pa'i sar tshe 'das zhes pa bcug par bya'o/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: tsitta snying gi dbus phyogs rtsa 'dab la: chos dbyings ye shes gsal ba'i 'od klong du: rnam snang dbyings phyug dkar gsal 'khril sbyor rol: 'khor lo dril 'dzin skyil krung gsal stong bzhugs: dbus phyogs sangs rgyas rigs kyi gtso bo la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba 'char dus der:

gti mug drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: chos dbyings ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad lam sna drongs: yum mchog dbyings phyug ma yis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: tsitta snying gi shar phyogs rtsa 'dab la: me long ye shes gsal ba'i 'od klong du: rdor sems spyan ma mthing gsal 'khril sbyor rol: rdo rje dril 'dzin skyil krung gsal stong bzhugs: g.yas su sa snying myu gu dril 'dzin dkar: g.yon du byams pa klu shing dril 'dzin dkar: mdun du lā se me long phyed skyil dkar: rgyab tu puṣpe me tog phyed skyil dkar: rdo rje rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug po la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba 'char dus der: zhe sdang drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: me long ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpas lam sna drongs: yum mchog sangs rgyas spyan mas rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: tsitta snying gi lho phyogs rtsa 'dab la: mnyam nyid ye shes gsal ba'i 'od klong du: rin 'byung ma ki ser gsal 'khril sbyor rol: rin chen dril 'dzin skyil krung gsal stong bzhugs: g.yas su kun bzang snye ma dril 'dzin ser: g.yon du nam snying ral gri dril 'dzin ser: mdun du mā le phreng 'dzin phyed skyil ser: rgyab tu dhu pe spos phor phyed skyil ser: rin chen rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug po la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba 'char dus der: nga rgyal drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe:

mnyam nyid ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan lam sna drongs: yum mchog ma ma ki yis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: tsitta snying gi nub phyogs rtsa 'dab la: sor rtogs ye shes gsal ba'i 'od klong du: snang mtha' gos dkar dmar gsal 'khril sbyor rol: padma dril 'dzin skyil krung gsal stong bzhugs: g.yas su spyan gzigs padma dril 'dzin dmar: g.yon du 'jam dpal ral gri dril 'dzin dmar: mdun du girti pi waṃ phyed skyil dmar: rgyab tu ā lo mar me phyed skyil dmar: padma rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug po la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba 'char dus der: 'dod chags drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: sor rtogs ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas lam sna drongs: yum mchog gos dkar mo yis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: tsitta snying gi byang phyogs rtsa 'dab la: bya grub ye shes gsal ba'i 'od klong du: don grub sgrol ma ljang gsal 'khril sbyor rol: rgya gram dril 'dzin skyil krung gsal stong bzhugs: g.yas su sgrib sel po ti dril 'dzin ljang : g.yon du phyag rdor rdo rje dril 'dzin ljang : mdun du ghandhe dung phor phyed skyil ljang : rgyab tu nirti zhal zas phyed skyil ljang : las kyi rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug po la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba 'char dus der: phrag dog drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: bya grub ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan don yod grub pas lam sna drongs:

yum mchog dam tshig sgrol mas rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: tsitta snying gi shar sgo'i rtsa 'dab la: rnam rgyal lcags kyu 'khril sbyor 'dor stabs dkar: tsitta snying gi lho sgo'i rtsa 'dab la: gshin rje zhags pa 'khril sbyor 'dor stabs ser: tsitta snying gi nub sgo'i rtsa 'dab la: rta mgrin lcags sgrog 'khril sbyor 'dor stabs dmar: tsitta snying gi byang sgo'i rtsa 'dab la: bdud rtsi dril bu 'khril sbyor 'dor stabs ljang : sprul pa'i sgo ba yab yum brgyad rnams la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba 'char dus der: bag chags drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: ye shes bzhi sbyor gsal ba'i 'od lam la: khro chen sgo ba bzhi yis lam sna drongs: yum mchog sgo ma bzhi yis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: spyi gtsug bde chen rtsa 'dab 'od klong du: dkar gsal thig le gsal 'tsher dkyil 'khor na: lha yi thub pa brgya byin pi waṃ dkar: nga rgyal lha yi skye sgo bcad du gsol: ltag rtsa ba men rwa 'dra'i 'od klong du: ljang gsal thig le gsal 'tsher dkyil 'khor na: lha min thub pa thags bzang go mtshon ljang : phrag dog lha min skye sgo bcad du gsol: srog rtsa shel gyi sbu gu'i 'od klong du: ser gsal thig le gsal 'tsher dkyil 'khor na: mi yi thub pa shāka thub gseg par ser: 'dod chags mi yi skye sgo bcad du gsol: lte ba rtsa 'khor 'khyil ba'i 'od klong du: mthing gsal thig le gsal 'tsher dkyil 'khor du: byol song thub pa seng ge po ti mthing : gti mug byol song skye sgo bcad du gsol: gsang gnas bde skyong rtsa 'dab 'od klong du:

dmar gsal thig le gsal 'tsher dkyil 'khor na: yi dwags thub pa kha 'bar sgrom bu dmar: ser sna yi dwags skye sgo bcad du gsol: rkang mthil rtsa 'khor 'khyil ba'i 'od klong du: nag gsal thig le gsal 'tsher dkyil 'khor na: dmyal ba'i thub pa chos rgyal me chu nag: zhe sdang dmyal ba'i skye sgo bcad du gsol: 'gro don mdzad pa'i sprul sku thub drug la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: srid pa bar do'i snang ba 'char dus der: bag chags drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: ye shes bzhi sbyor gsal ba'i 'od lam la: thub chen gong ma gsum pos lam sna drongs: thub chen 'og ma gsum pos rgyab nas skyor: ma dag rigs drug 'od lam bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhi ba'i lha tshogs bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ni: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'od zer 'bar: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul zhi ba'i sku: mtshan dang dpe byad rgyan rnams mdzes tshul ldan: zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba 'char dus der: dug lnga drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: ye shes lnga ldan gsal ba'i 'od lam la: zhi ba yab rnams kun gyis lam sna drongs: dbyings kyi yum chen rnams kyis rgyab nas skyor: sgo ba sgo ma rnams kyis mtha' nas brten: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: skye gnas bar dor gnas pa'i dus 'di ru: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis lha tshogs rnams: bdag lus tsitta snying gi gzhal yas su: 'od lnga tshom bu'i sku ru gsal bar bzhugs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: zhi ba'i lha tshogs snying gi nang nas thon:

mdun gyi mkha' la nam mkha' gang bar 'char: rgyan dang cha lugs gtso 'khor grangs med pa: 'ja' 'od klong nas gsal stong 'od lnga'i sku: ye shes lnga yi 'od lam zer thag 'tsher: lnga ldan thig le sgra 'od zer du 'phro: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug mdangs ldan rang sgrar bcas: bdag gi snying gar zug pa'i tshul du 'char: ye shes lnga yi 'od dang lhan cig tu: ma dag 'khrul pa'i rigs drug 'od lam drug: bdag la 'char bar gyur pa'i dus kyi tshe: bcom ldan zhi ba'i lha tshogs thugs rje can: thugs rje can rnams thugs rje der ma chung : ye shes bzhi sbyor lam la bdag drongs shig: ma dag rigs drug lam las bzlog tu gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab la: 'ja' dang 'od du 'thib pa'i klong dkyil du: longs spyod 'khor lo dbus kyi rtsa 'dab la: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin chen po ni: padma gar gyi dbang phyug 'od lnga'i mdangs: ye shes mkha' 'gro dmar gsal bde stong 'khril: gri gug thod khrag phyag rgya nam mkhar bsgyur: sku yi rig 'dzin rnams kyis 'gro ba skyobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: mgrin pa longs spyod shar gyi rtsa 'dab la: sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin chen po ni: dkar gsal 'dzum mdangs mkha' 'gro dkar mo 'khril: gri gug thod khrag phyag rgya nam mkhar bsgyur: thugs kyi rig 'dzin rnams kyis 'gro ba skyobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: mgrin pa longs spyod lho yi rtsa 'dab la: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin chen po ni: ser gsal 'dzum mdangs mkha' 'gro ser mo 'khril: gri gug thod khrag phyag rgya nam mkhar bsgyur: yon tan rig 'dzin rnams kyis 'gro ba skyobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: mgrin pa longs spyod nub kyi rtsa 'dab la: phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin chen po ni: dmar gsal 'dzum mdangs mkha' 'gro dmar mo 'khril: gri gug thod khrag phyag rgya nam mkhar bsgyur: gsung gi rig 'dzin rnams kyis 'gro ba skyobs:

oṃ āḥhūm̐: mgrin pa longs spyod byang gi rtsa 'dab la: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin chen po ni: ljang gsal khro 'dzum mkha' 'gro ljang gu 'khril: gri gug thod khrag phyag rgya nam mkhar bsgyur: phrin las rig 'dzin rnams kyis 'gro ba skyobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba 'char dus der: bag chags drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: lhan skyes ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: dpa' bo rig 'dzin rnams kyis lam sna drongs: yum mchog mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: dag pa mkha' spyod zhing khams de ru skyol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: skye gnas bar dor gnas pa'i dus 'di ru: rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas rnams: bdag lus mgrin pa longs spyod gzhal yas su: 'od lnga tshom bu'i sku ru gsal bar bzhugs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: rig 'dzin lha tshogs mgrin pa'i nang nas thon: nam mkha' gang bar mdun gyi mkha' la 'char: rol mo'i sgra dang gar stabs sna tshogs bsgyur: 'jig rten khams kun shig shig yom yom 'gul: lhan skyes ye shes 'od lam zer thag 'tsher: gti mug dud 'gro'i lam snang 'char dus der: rig 'dzin lha tshogs thugs rje der ma chung : gti mug dud 'gro'i lam nas bzlog tu gsol: lhan skyes ye shes lam la 'gro ba drongs: bar do rang ngo shes par thugs rjes zungs: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su dbang bskur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i spyi bo ru: klad pa dung khang 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su: 'ja' 'od me dpung thig le'i 'od klong du: khrag 'thung lha tshogs tshom bu'i sku ru bzhugs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: klad pa dung khang dbus kyi rtsa 'dabs su:

'ja' 'od me dpung thig le'i 'od klong du: kun tu bzang po che mchog he ru ka: zhal gsum phyag drug smug nag dkar dmar zhal: g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rnge'u chung bsnams: g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar rgyu zhags bsnams: kro ti shwa ri gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: gtso bo yab yum gnyis kyis 'gro kun drongs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dung khang dbus kyi rtsa 'dabs khri rkang steng : 'ja' 'od me dpung thig le'i 'od klong du: rnam par snang mdzad buddha he ru ka: zhal gsum phyag drug smug nag dkar dmar zhal: g.yas gsum 'khor lo dgra st+wa ral gri bsnams: g.yon gsum dril bu thong gshol bhan dmar bsnams: buddha kro ti gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: khrag 'thung bde gshegs rigs kyis 'gro kun drongs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: klad pa dung khang shar gyi rtsa 'dabs su: 'ja' 'od me dpung thig le'i 'od klong du: rdo rje sems dpa' badzra he ru ka: zhal gsum phyag drug mthing nag dkar dmar zhal: g.yas gsum rdo rje bhandha dgra st+wa bsnams: g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar thong gshol bsnams: badzra kro ti gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: khrag 'thung rdo rje rigs kyis 'gro kun drongs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: klad pa dung khang lho yi rtsa 'dabs su: 'ja' 'od me dpung thig le'i 'od klong du: rin chen 'byung ldan ratna he ru ka: zhal gsum phyag drug ser nag dkar dmar zhal: g.yas gsum rin chen kha ṭwāṃ be con bsnams: g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar tri shul bsnams: ratna kro ti gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: khrag 'thung rin chen rigs kyis 'gro kun drongs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: klad pa dung khang nub kyi rtsa 'dabs su: 'ja' 'od me dpung thig le'i 'od klong du: snang ba mtha' yas padma he ru ka: zhal gsum phyag drug dmar nag dkar sngo zhal: g.yas gsum padma kha ṭwāṃ dbyug to bsnams: g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar rnge'u chung bsnams:

padma kro ti gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: khrag 'thung padma rigs kyis 'gro kun drongs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: klad pa dung khang byang gi rtsa 'dabs su: 'ja' 'od me dpung thig le'i 'od klong du: don yod grub pa karma he ru ka: zhal gsum phyag drug ljang nag dkar dmar zhal: g.yas gsum ral gri kha ṭwāṃ dbyug to bsnams: g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar thong gshol bsnams: karma kro ti gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: khrag 'thung las kyi rigs kyis 'gro kun drongs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: khrag 'thung gtso bo yab yum bcu gnyis la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba 'char dus der: 'khrul snang drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: ye shes lnga rdzogs gsal ba'i 'od lam la: khrag 'thung khro rgyal rnams kyis lam sna drongs: dbyings phyug khro mo'i tshogs kyis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dung khang shar gyi rtsa 'dabs 'od klong du: ko'u rī dkar mo zhing dbyug bhandha 'dzin: dung khang lho yi rtsa 'dabs 'od klong du: tsau'u rī ser mo mda' gzhu 'gengs shing 'phen: dung khang nub kyi rtsa 'dabs 'od klong du: pra mo dmar mo chu srin rgyal mtshan 'dzin: dung khang byang gi rtsa 'dabs 'od klong du: be ta nag mo rdo rje bhan dmar 'dzin: dung khang shar lho'i rtsa 'dabs 'od klong du: puska dmar ser rgyu ma 'dren cing gsol: dung khang lho nub rtsa 'dabs 'od klong du: ghasma ljang nag rdo rje bhan dmar dkrug: dung khang nub byang rtsa 'dabs 'od klong du: tsandha ser skya tsitta bam chen za: dung khang byang shar rtsa 'dabs 'od klong du: sme sha mthing nag bam ro mgo lus 'bral: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnas kyi kau'u rī ma mo brgyad rnams la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs:

bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba 'char dus der: 'khrul snang drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: sgra 'od zer gsum gsal ba'i 'od lam la: ko'u ri ma mo bzhi yis lam sna drongs: puska ma mo bzhi yis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dung khang shar gyi rtsa 'dabs phyi ma la: sengha smug nag seng gdong khar ro thogs: dung khang lho yi rtsa 'dabs phyi ma la: bya kri dmar mo stag gdong lag gnyis bsnol: dung khang nub kyi rtsa 'dabs phyi ma la: sri la nag mo wa gdong rgyu ma za: dung khang byang gi rtsa 'dabs phyi ma la: shwa na mthing nag spyang gdong bam ro 'drad: dung khang shar lho'i rtsa 'dabs phyi ma la: kri ta dkar ser rgod mgo zhing phrag gzar: dung khang lho nub rtsa 'dabs phyi ma la: kaṅka dmar nag kang mgo zhing chen khur: dung khang nub byang rtsa 'dabs phyi ma la: kha khwa nag mo bya rog bhan gri gdeng : dung khang byang shar rtsa 'dabs phyi ma la: hu lu mthing nag 'ug gdong rdo rje 'dzin: yul bdag sengha phra men brgyad rnams la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba 'char dus der: 'khrul snang drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: rang snang yul brgyad dag pa'i 'od lam la: sengha phra men bzhi yis lam sna drongs: kri ta phra men bzhi yis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: klad pa dung khang shar sgo'i rtsa 'dabs la: rta gdong dkar mo lcags kyu bhandha 'dzin: klad pa dung khang lho sgo'i rtsa 'dabs la: phag gdong ser mo zhags pa bhandha 'dzin: klad pa dung khang nub sgo'i rtsa 'dabs la: seng gdong dmar mo lcags sgrog bhandha 'dzin: klad pa dung khang byang sgo'i rtsa 'dabs la:

sbrul gdong ljang gu dril bu bhandha 'dzin: sprul pa'i ye shes sgo ma bzhi rnams la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba 'char dus der: 'khrul snang drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: skye ba rnam bzhi 'khrul pa'i sgo chod la: phrin las rnam bzhi dag pa'i sgo phyes nas: lcags kyu zhags pa ma yis lam sna drongs: lcags sgrog dril bu ma yis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dung khang shar gyi phyi khyams rtsa phran la: zhi ba'i las mdzad rnal 'byor dbang phyug drug: srin mo dkar smug g.yag gdong rdo rje 'dzin: tshangs pa dkar ser sbrul gdong padma 'dzin: lha chen dkar ljang gzig gdong tri shul 'dzin: gtogs 'dod dkar sngo spre gdong 'khor lo 'dzin: gzhon nu dkar dmar dred gdong mdung thung 'dzin: brgya byin dkar mo dom mgo rgyu zhags 'dzin: shar nas zhi ba'i las mdzad rnal 'byor drug: bar dor 'jigs skrag zhi ba'i las mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dung khang lho yi phyi khyams rtsa phran la: rgyas pa'i las mdzad rnal 'byor dbang phyug drug: rdo rje ser mo pha waṃ spu gri 'dzin: zhi ba dmar ser chu srin bum pa 'dzin: bdud rtsi dmar ser sdig gdong padma 'dzin: zla ba dkar ser khra mgo rdo rje 'dzin: be con ser ljang wa gdong dbyug to 'dzin: srin mo ser nag stag gdong thod khrag thogs: lho nas rgyas pa'i las mdzad rnal 'byor drug: bar dor ye shes rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dung khang nub kyi phyi khyams rtsa phran la: dbang gi las mdzad rnal 'byor dbang phyug drug: za ba dmar ljang rgod mgo be con 'dzin: dga' ba dmar mo rta gdong khog chen 'dzin: stobs chen dmar skya khyung gdong dbyug to 'dzin: srin mo dmar mo khyi gdong rdo rje 'dzin:

'dod pa dmar mo pu shud mda' gzhu 'gengs: nor srung dmar ljang sha mgo bum pa 'dzin: nub nas dbang gi las mdzad rnal 'byor drug: bar dor rang dbang thob pa'i las mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dung khang byang gi phyi khyams rtsa phran la: drag po'i las mdzad rnal 'byor dbang phyug drug: rlung lha ljang sngon spyang gdong ba dan phyar: mi mo ljang dmar skyin mgo gsal shing 'dzin: phag mo ljang nag phag gdong mche zhags 'dzin: dga' byed ljang dmar khwa gdong zhing chung 'dzin: sna chen ljang nag glang chen bam chen 'dzin: chu lha ljang sngon sbrul gdong sbrul zhags 'dzin: byang nas drag po'i las mdzad rnal 'byor drug: bar dor 'khrul snang brlag pa'i las mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dung khang shar sgor khu byug lcags kyu dkar: dung khang lho sgor ra gdong zhags pa ser: dung khang nub sgor seng gdong lcags sgrog dmar: dung khang byang sgor sbrul gdong dril bu ljang : sprul pa'i las mdzad dbang phyug sgo ma bzhi: bar dor skye sgo bkag pa'i las mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba 'char dus der: 'khrul snang drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: sgra 'od zer gsum gsal ba'i 'od lam la: shar gyi dbang phyug bdun gyis lam sna drongs: lho yi dbang phyug bdun gyis rgyab nas skyor: nub kyi dbang phyug bdun gyis mtha' nas brten: byang gi dbang phyug bdun gyis gshed dang phrol: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: skye gnas bar dor gnas pa'i dus 'di ru: khrag 'thung drug cu tham pa'i lha tshogs rnams: spyi bo klad pa dung khang gzhal yas su: 'od lnga tshom bu'i sku ru gsal bar bzhugs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag:

khrag 'thung lha tshogs klad pa'i nang nas thon: stong gsum 'jig rten ma lus gang bar 'char: rgyan dang cha lugs gtso 'khor 'jigs tshul can: sgra 'od zer gsum klong nas khro bo'i sku: sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can: rgod dang gshed dang rngams pa'i nga ro sgrogs: snying rje khro dang gtum pa'i zhe sdang 'bar: thal chen khrag thig zhag gi zo ris brgyan: ko rlon g.yang gzhi stag gi sham thabs gsol: thod phreng sbrul chun brgyan cing me dpung 'bar: ha ha hūm̐ phaṭa rgyob sod 'brug stong ldir: mgo brnyan sna tshogs phyag mtshan ston cing bsgyur: stong gsum rab 'byams shig shig yom yom 'gul: sgra 'od zer dang dngangs skrag 'jigs snang kun: bdag la 'char bar gyur pa'i dus kyi tshe: khrag 'thung khro bo'i lha tshogs thugs rje can: thugs rje can rnams thugs rje der ma chung : bag chags drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: dngangs skrag 'jigs snang spangs pa'i 'od lam la: khrag 'thung khro bo'i tshogs kyis lam sna drongs: dbyings phyug khro mo'i tshogs kyis rgyab nas skyor: ke'u seng sgo ma'i tshogs kyis mtha' nas brten: spor byed chen mo brgyad kyis gnas nas spor: dbang phyug mgo brnyan tshogs kyis bar chad sol: sgo ma chen mo bzhi yis skye sgo khog: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dga' ba'i grogs dang bral nas gcig pur 'khyams: rang snang stong pa'i gzugs brnyan 'char dus der: sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje'i shugs phyungs nas: dngangs skrag bar do'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung shog: ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lnga 'char dus der: mi 'jigs mi skrag rang ngo shes gyur cig: zhi dang khro bo'i sku gzugs 'char dus der: mi 'jigs gdeng thob bar do ngo shes shog: las ngan dbang gis sdug bsngal myong tsam na: yi dam lha yis sdug bsngal sel bar shog:

chos nyid rang sgra 'brug stong ldir tsam na: theg chen chos kyi sgra ru 'gyur bar shog: skyabs med las kyi rjes su 'brang dus der: thugs rje chen pos bdag sogs bskyab tu gsol: bag chags las kyi sdug bsngal myong dus der: 'od gsal bde ba'i ting 'dzin 'char bar shog: 'byung lnga'i khams rnams dgra ru mi ldang zhing : sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i zhing khams mthong bar shog: bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs thugs rje dang : bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mthus: smon lam ci btab deng 'dir 'grub par shog: ces zhi khro'i chos spyod smon lam dang bcas pa 'di la dus gsum du brtson pas 'bad par gyur na mtshams med pa lnga byas pa'i sdig sgrib kyang tshe 'di nyid la 'dag cing na raka dmyal ba'i gnas kyang dong nas sprugs te rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du skye bar the tshom med do: kun tu bzang po nyid kyi bka' las kyang : gang zhig sgyu 'phrul zhi khro yi: dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal na: nyams chag kun kyang byang 'gyur te: mtshams med lnga yi sdig kyang 'byang : na raka gnas kyang dong sprugs te: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags: zhes pas chos spyod de ltar tshul bzhin du byas pa'i phan yon ni de lta bu dang : dkyil 'khor gyi lha 'di rnams kyi mtshan lan gcig thos pas kyang ngan song gi gnas su mi skye zhing mthar 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur gsungs te: dpal kun tu bzang po nyid kyi zhal nas: gal te rnal 'byor pa gang zhig gis dkyil 'khor gyi lha 'di rnams kyi mtshan rna bar lan gcig thos pa tsam gyis kyang na raka chen por mi ltung ngo : zhes gsungs pa dang : rang bzhin sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor la: gang zhig gus pas phyag 'tshal na: nyams chag kun kyang 'byang bar 'gyur: dam tshig bskang nas dngos grub thob: ces gsungs pa'i phyir: phan yon brjod las 'das pa yod pas de bas na bdag lus zhi khro'i lha tshogs su gsal gdab cing chos spyod la brtson par gyis shig:

tshe 'di nyid la yang mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob cing : tshe 'phos nas kyang chos nyid bar dor zhi khro'i snang ba shar ba'i tshe gnyis su med par thim nas sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro: nyams su longs shig: gshed ma brgya yis bdas kyang 'di'i tshig don yid la ma brjed par gyis shig: zungs shig: chongs shig: klog cig: kun chub par gyis shig: tshul bzhin du yid la gyis shig: zhi khro 'dus pa'i chos spyod rab gsal bar do thos grol gyi nyams len: zhi khro'i las byang tshor ba rang grol gyi snying po: bar do gsang ba rig pa rang grol gyi cha rkyen: bskang bshags nyams chag rang grol gyi dngos gzhi: skyes bu skal ldan rnams kyi thar lam: chos spyod bag chags rang grol zhes bya ba: 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du ma rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: grub thob karma gling pas gter nas gdan drangs pa'o:
